summary.key_theme: ServiceNow 憑藉強勁的第二季財報表現與 AI 業務成長動能，獲得華爾街分析師調升目標價，儘管面臨軟體類股整體市場波動與部分獲利了結壓力。

bullish.title: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight on ServiceNow, Raises Price Target to $175

bullish.title: What’s Going On With ServiceNow (NOW)? — ServiceNow (NOW) is back in focus after a beat and raise second quarter

bullish.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Unveils Autonomous Security to Accelerate Growth
